en.headline: 217 own commits across 12 repos, with sandbox, skill and pixel tooling work
en.teaser: Most of the window went into the agent sandbox knowledge base, two OpenCode skills and the pixel logo toolkit, plus issue reports on OpenChamber, PowerToys and opencode.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-24 with no missing days. Across 12 repositories the account recorded 217 own commits, 1 pull request, 5 issue actions and 0 reviews; a further 578 automated commits landed in the profile repository.

### Agent sandbox and knowledge base

The largest share of work went to `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, where documentation commits filled in the knowledge base: VS Code harness and AI-disabled file locations, a SenseNova image skill quick reference with a correction that Windows does not need WSL2, multi-provider completion rules with 300ms debounce semantics, and tightened AGENTS.md branch discipline. Eval entries were added and reorganized, including the Iceman pelican-on-bike variant and an octopus animation moved to the deepseek-v4.1-flash group. One pull request was opened there.

### OpenCode skills

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` shipped v1.1.0 and v1.2.0: the four actions now return a single JSON object with a declared output schema, disable/enable writes were serialized to avoid concurrent overwrites, and the bilingual documentation site was updated. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` shipped v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1, covering priced accounting with Console calibration, a large documentation reduction with a single `go.mjs` entry point, and an enforced candidate menu with per-source chains.

### Pixel tooling and reports

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` released v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 with automatic text wrapping, overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, a Korean font fix and a 40-image command gallery. `sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` received mobile viewport fixes at 375 and 414 widths, a single-button theme menu, visual refinements and three merged plugin entries. `sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` added ported OpenChamber plugins and skills, a hidden-files toggle and Chinese documentation.

### Profile, blog and translation

The profile repository `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` had 13 own commits plus 578 automated commits, reworking the daily report workflow gate, feeding full release notes into AI summaries and rejecting bare issue counts. `sogeisetsu/myBlog` added screenshots for OpenChamber session retention and a DSH stats bug, and `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` documented the Google 2 key path.

### Upstream issue work

Issue actions went to `openchamber/openchamber` (storage management, a missing Console MCP server in settings, and an outdated session retention hint), `microsoft/PowerToys` (a Shortcut Guide NullReferenceException) and `anomalyco/opencode` (no way to run the shipped Windows CLI).

zh.headline: 12 个仓库共 217 次本人提交，集中在沙箱、技能与像素工具
zh.teaser: 本窗口主要投入 agent 沙箱知识库、两个 OpenCode 技能和像素 Logo 工具，并向 OpenChamber、PowerToys 与 opencode 提交了 issue。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-26 至 2026-11-24，没有缺失日期。12 个仓库共记录 217 次本人提交、1 个拉取请求、5 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论）和 0 次评审；另有 578 次自动提交落在个人主页仓库。

### Agent 沙箱与知识库

工作量最大的是 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`，文档提交持续补充知识库：VS Code harness 与关闭 AI 功能的落盘位置、SenseNova 图像技能速查并纠正 Windows 不必上 WSL2、多 provider 补全并存规则与 300ms 防抖语义，以及收紧 AGENTS.md 的分支纪律。评测条目有新增和整理，包括 Iceman 版鹈鹕骑车，以及把章鱼动画归到 deepseek-v4.1-flash 分组。该仓库还开出了 1 个拉取请求。

### OpenCode 技能

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 发布了 v1.1.0 和 v1.2.0：四个动作改为输出单个 JSON 对象并声明 output schema，disable/enable 写入串行化以避免并发覆盖，双语文档站同步更新。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 发布了 v2.0.0、v3.0.0 和 v3.0.1，分别涉及带定价的核算与 Console 校准、大幅压缩文档并统一到 `go.mjs` 单一入口、以及强制候选菜单与按来源的链长。

### 像素工具与报告

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 发布 v0.2.0 和 v0.3.0，带来文本自动折行、溢出保护、双语命令行、韩语字体修正和 40 张命令示例画廊。`sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复了 375 与 414 真实视口的移动端适配，主题切换改为单按钮弹出菜单，并做了视觉精修和三个插件的并入。`sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` 新增移植的 OpenChamber 插件与技能、隐藏文件开关和中文文档。

### 主页、博客与翻译

主页仓库 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 13 次本人提交，另有 578 次自动提交，改造了日报 workflow 的生成物校验门禁，把 release notes 全量喂入 AI 摘要，并拒收裸计数表述。`sogeisetsu/myBlog` 补充了 OpenChamber 会话保留提示和 DSH 统计 bug 的截图，`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 记录了 Google 2 密钥的获取路径。

### 上游 issue

issue 互动分布在 `openchamber/openchamber`（存储管理、设置页缺少 Console MCP 服务器、过期的会话保留提示）、`microsoft/PowerToys`（Shortcut Guide 的 NullReferenceException）和 `anomalyco/opencode`（Windows 桌面自带 CLI 却无法运行）。
